pricingMetadata.sourcePortal: Huawei Cloud International Pricing Calculator - Product Pricing Details
pricingMetadata.ecsPricingScope: Linux ECS and BYOL M7n ECS. X0/X1 and C7n use ONDEMAND hourly amount plus the higher RI perPrice value when Product Pricing Details exposes multiple RI rows for the same spec. M7n uses Product Pricing Details, RI billing mode, BYOL, 1-year page semantics, with NO_UPFRONT perPrice as the RI monthly fee and ONDEMAND hourly amount as the on-demand fee. RVTools matching priority is General Computing first, then General Computing-plus, then Memory-optimized.
pricingMetadata.evsPricingScope: EVS High I/O and General Purpose SSD ONDEMAND hourly price per GB.
